issues_found: Mission auto-completion failed due to strict string matching and lack of synonym support in Analyzing/CycleEnd stages.
CLI restart loop occurred because a double-increment bug in conductor retries caused erratic halting behavior.
JSON extraction was brittle, failing on LLM responses with markdown or additional prose.
Dashboard process detection was prone to false positives from decoy processes like 'tail' or 'grep' matching the script name.
